title: Export current-page order and receipt count groups to Excel
description: A sales user downloads the selected current-page count grouping alongside the two existing order and unlinked-receipt evidence worksheets. Reuse ERP-170 group data and the existing authorized bounded export request, current-user sales-order menu and salesperson scope; retain HTTP audit. Add separate order-group and receipt-group sheets only for a supported non-none group mode, preserving the original two-sheet default. Escape formula-leading labels, keep unknown and truncation warnings visible, and never sum amounts or match receipts to orders. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, direct model database access, schema/migrations, production SQL or real database execution, writes, secrets/.env changes, deployment or real-browser acceptance. Verify focused workbook tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Excel export validates the finite GroupBy value before source reads and builds from the same authorized bounded current-page preview; none mode retains the existing two-sheet workbook.

Supported grouping adds distinct order-count and unlinked-receipt-count sheets with current-page labels, numeric counts, explicit inapplicable/empty and truncation states, and formula-safe text; no amount totals or inferred links appear.
Workbook unit tests cover modes, denied access, unknown/empty/truncated groups, formula-leading labels and original worksheets; document export scope and pass safe Release build/test.
